content.short: Etherfuse is a tokenized sovereign bond and FX platform for treasuries and fintechs.
content.description: Etherfuse issues tokenized sovereign debt as Stablebonds and Sovereign Coins, letting a treasury hold yield-bearing government-backed collateral on-chain. The same assets serve as a float and FX instrument, with USD to MXN conversion the company prices at a tenth of bank cost and settles instantly. Holders can use positions for yield, liquidity, collateral or payments. Onboarding runs through a KYC and compliance process aimed at businesses moving money across borders.
content.meta: Tokenized sovereign bonds beyond US Treasuries, with FX rails for treasuries and fintechs.
